routing_warnings.description: The freelancer's sketch-completion claim concerns the drawing deliverable rather than specifically verifying the three-dwelling subdivision.
This message changes Unit 1 to a 2+1 configuration without changing the total number of dwellings.
This message evaluates Unit 3's kitchen-counter placement and bathroom-door clearance rather than changing the subdivision.
This message establishes a separate steel entrance door for each unit, which is owned by the narrower entrance Requirement.
The 10 cm room-wall shift is specifically intended to narrow the common corridor rather than modify the project-wide wall-preservation policy.
The requested relocation of Unit 3's shower and drain belongs to the Unit 3 bathroom layout.
This message concerns the independently revisable position and bathroom-door clearance of Unit 3's kitchen counter.
The kitchen-related clause concerns relocating Unit 3's counter and coordinating it with the bathroom door, not the common cabinetry specification.
This proposal concerns swapping Unit 1's kitchen and common-bathroom locations.
This message requests clarification of the final decision about swapping Unit 1's kitchen and bathroom.
The requested conversion of the No1 bathroom sliding door to a normal door concerns the separately tracked Unit 1 common bathroom.
The inward-opening No1 bathroom door and bathroom expansion concern the Unit 1 common bathroom rather than the en-suite.
The reported door-to-sink collision concerns the Unit 1 common bathroom door trajectory.
The request is to add the en-suite wall-to-door-edge dimension to the drawing, which is a dimension-annotation deliverable.
The freelancer's immediate commitment concerns adding the requested en-suite dimension annotation.
The request to display Unit 3 bathroom width and bathroom-door offsets concerns drawing dimension annotations rather than changing the bathroom layout.
The toilet-relocation request occurs in the Unit 1 kitchen/common-bathroom discussion and does not identify Unit 3.
The instruction to remove the purple-marked walls concerns the wall-preservation strategy rather than corridor-space allocation.
The request to place refrigerators concerns kitchen layout rather than corridor-space allocation.
The instruction to move Unit 3's drain and shower to the left wall belongs to the Unit 3 bathroom layout.
The wall-preservation clause changes the architectural layout strategy rather than the floor-plan artifact requirement; the same message's kitchen clauses belong to REQ_OPEN_PLAN_KITCHEN_CABINETRY.

The room-dimension request belongs to the dimension-annotation deliverable; the furniture request belongs to REQ_FURNISHED_LAYOUT_DRAWING, while the bathroom-door and fixture-placement clauses affect bathroom layout Requirements.
This message requests a specific wall-to-door-edge dimension annotation rather than changing the general floor-plan drawing requirement.
The request to replace Unit 1's sliding bathroom door with a normal door belongs to the narrower door-configuration Requirement.
The collision analysis concerns the independently tracked Unit 1 common-bathroom door configuration.
The inward-opening door request belongs to the narrower door-configuration Requirement; only the bathroom expansion is retained here.
The observed sink collision and remaining door clearance concern the bathroom door configuration rather than the broader fixture and plumbing layout.
Swapping the kitchen and common bathroom is a relative room-placement decision explicitly excluded from the target Requirement.
The request to place sink and shower dimensions on the plan belongs to the dimension-annotation Requirement; only the toilet relocation is retained here.
The unresolved final decision about swapping the kitchen and bathroom belongs to the relative room-placement Requirement.
